transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I'm Vivek Iyer. I've been having terrible network issues at my home on 171 MG Road, and it's getting ridiculous.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing network problems, Mr. Iyer. Before we look into your account, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Sure, it is 56165549. My phone number is 95468 71154.
Agent: Thank you for that information. I can see your account is active. I understand how frustrating it is when your connection is unstable, and I really want to get this sorted for you.
Customer: It's just not working. I've had enough. I want to cancel my service and switch to another provider immediately.
Agent: I'm sorry to see you go. To proceed with the cancellation, I must inform you that there is an early-termination fee of fifty dollars, and your final bill will arrive within thirty days of the closing date.
Customer: Fifty dollars? You're charging me to leave because your network is broken? This is absolutely outrageous!
Agent: I understand your frustration. I will raise a network ticket right now to have our engineers investigate the signal strength in your area.
Customer: I don't care about a ticket! I told you I want to cancel. Just do it now!
Agent: I can certainly process the cancellation request for you, but since you are requesting a termination due to service failure, I need to escalate this to my supervisor for approval of the fee waiver request.
Customer: This is a joke. I've wasted my time and I'm still not getting a resolution. I am beyond dissatisfied with Nimbus Telecom!
Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience. I have logged the ticket and the escalation to my supervisor. Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for calling, and goodbye.
